title: FireReport
description: A report of fire from a person, a drone or a crew. Its weight in the noisy-OR confidence is statement x location quality x observer distance x independence. The voice intake fills the classes; the operator screen clusters reports and the operator confirms them.

uncertainty_m.description: Radius of the location uncertainty: a circle, not a point.

statement_class.description: What the person says: 'I see flames' 0.6, 'fire is close' 0.4, 'smoke' 0.15, heard of it 0.05.

location_quality.description: GPS / shared pin 1.0, an address 0.7, 'near X' 0.4.

observer_distance.description: On site 1.0, closer than 500 m 0.8, far 0.4.

source_ref.description: Hashed phone number (never the number itself), crew or drone id. The same value twice is not an independent source.

language.description: ISO 639-1, e.g. tr, el, en, de.

confidence.description: Weight of this report in the noisy-OR (0 for a repeat from the same number).
